criteria.criterion: A lifecycle test in which the producer, on the send-back pass, reports only some criteria but leaves real changes reaches the verifier and does not end in the 'still had problems when sent back' failure; run `cargo test`.
criteria.evidence: In `a_criterion_missing_from_the_report_counts_as_unmet`, both reports cover only criterion 1 and the producer leaves edits. The test checks that the second brief lists the missing criterion and that the verifier's inputs contain `producer-report-gaps` with that criterion's text, so the job reached the verifier. `a_criterion_still_unmet_after_the_send_back_reaches_the_verifier_flagged` also checks that the reason does not contain 'still had problems when sent back' and that the verifier ran. All 6 targeted tests passed.
commands: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle -- send_back full_test_result criterion_missing no_full_test_check

criteria.criterion: A test where the producer makes no change after send-back still fails the job; run `cargo test`.
criteria.evidence: `a_criterion_still_unmet_after_the_send_back_with_no_change_fails_the_job` and `a_producer_that_still_has_no_full_test_result_and_makes_no_change_fails` set `edits = Vec::new()`. Both check that the job ends Failed, that the reason contains 'made no change' plus the gap, and that the verifier never ran. Both passed.
commands: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle -- send_back full_test_result criterion_missing no_full_test_check

criteria.criterion: The unreported or unmet criteria and any missing test result from the last report are kept in the attempt invocation's detail and passed to the verifier as context, so the verifier judges them rather than the self-check.
criteria.evidence: run.rs:702-716 still writes the self-check problems and the redacted report into the attempt's `detail`. Lines 724-726 keep the problems as `report_gaps`. At about line 1013 they are added to the verifier's inputs as a `producer-report-gaps` entry under the checks. That entry is marked passed and explicitly tells the verifier to judge the gaps itself and run `cargo test --locked`. Lifecycle tests confirm the verifier receives both the criterion text and the missing-test text.

criteria.criterion: The send-back prompt text in run.rs no longer says a still-missing criterion fails the job, and matches the new behavior.
criteria.evidence: run.rs:746-749 now says that if the changes are still in place, they go to the verifier with the unmet or unreported criteria flagged, and that a run leaving no change fails. The send-back text for a missing test result (733-739) never mentioned failure.

criteria.criterion: A CHANGELOG line and a decision entry record the change and why, citing job 582g.
criteria.evidence: CHANGELOG.md gains a Fixed entry that cites job 20261016-005953-582g, names the root cause (the give-up policy in `produce_and_verify`) and points to D103. docs/decisions.md adds D103 with case, decision, alternatives, tradeoff, reversal cost and provenance, also citing 582g.

findings.summary: The producer prompt still says a `not-run` full test result fails the job after one send-back, and D103 says the producer prompt was updated to match the new behavior.
findings.evidence: producer.md line 9: "`not-run` is not acceptable: Athena sends that report back once, then fails the job." Under the new code, a missing test result with changes now goes to the verifier. Only the criteria line (line 10) was updated. D103 says "The send-back prompt and producer prompt now say this."

findings.summary: `crates/athena-cli/tests/common/mod.rs` was on the expected deliverables list but was not changed.
findings.evidence: The tests use the existing `seen_by_verifier` and `edits` fields of the scenario. Leaving this file unchanged is within scope.

summary: The change does what was asked, so the verdict is pass. Before, when the producer's report was still incomplete after its one send-back, the job failed. Now, in `produce_and_verify` in `crates/athena-core/src/run.rs`, the work goes to the verifier if the producer left changes, and only a run with no changes fails. The last report is still saved with the attempt's record. The verifier is told which criteria were unmet or unreported, and whether the full test result was missing, through a `producer-report-gaps` entry that is not a check and fails nothing. The send-back prompt, the CHANGELOG and a new decision entry (D103, citing job 582g) were all updated. Lifecycle tests cover both paths for each kind of gap: work with changes reaches the verifier with the gaps flagged, and work with no changes fails. I ran the targeted tests, the full test suite, clippy and fmt myself, and all passed. One minor problem: `producer.md` line 9 still tells producers that a `not-run` test result fails the job after the send-back. That is no longer true, and D103 says that prompt was updated.
